_README: A worked example of a FINISHED config, with every name generalised. It shows the
shape of each section once the vocabulary decisions have been made with a human.
Nothing in it describes your estate.
Do NOT copy this file. Run `modindex.py init` in your repo and let it detect the
layout, then use this as a reference for what a FINISHED config looks like --
particularly the segment_blacklist, which is always the site-specific part that
Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the build.

modules._comment: core = the SAP modules this customer actually runs. buckets = concerns that are not SAP modules; name them X_* so they read as different. open = report evidence for anything else instead of dropping it.

not_modules.PS: 0 objects write any PS table; the ZPS_* objects are WBS-settlement helpers owned by CO

naming._comment: The blacklist is the highest-leverage setting in this file. Every entry here was confirmed from the objects' own short texts: GRP is a shared layer and ENT1/ENT2 are legal entities, IM is 'implementation', RF is the handheld layer (covered by a family rule instead), EXCEL/REST are technical layers.

text._comment: secondary_script splits bilingual short texts into two columns, so the local team reads its own language and a reviewer reads English. Keywords only feed R8 (WEAK).

tuning._comment: Defaults, restated so they are visible. Change them only with a measured reason.

assertions.name: every RF handheld unit ticks WM
everything in the e-invoicing package ticks FI
